method.description: Public official download of one Massachusetts document. The official index at https://www.mass.gov/lists/court-forms-for-criminal-records was fetched first and the document's own link read from it; the binary was then fetched by direct HTTPS GET from the URL recorded below. The response was classified by the repository's own hardened acquisition validator (scripts/lib/rcap-factory/acquisition-response.mjs), which ran block detection first and found no perimeter signature. Every property recorded here was measured from the retrieved bytes: the digest with SHA-256, the page count, encryption, AcroForm and XFA structure, the document-level JavaScript name tree, the widget annotations page by page and the terminal field list with its types, and the revision block read from the extracted form face.
method.binaryDeposition: The retrieved binary is not committed. This job's ownedPaths are limited to this single production-factory JSON file, and the bytes were measured outside the repository and left there.
method.byteVerificationNote: Every digest, count and structural fact in this record was measured in this job from the bytes this job retrieved. Nothing is carried forward from the registry, the intelligence or a held copy.

automationBlockRetest.resultDetail: The official index and all five assigned binary endpoints answered HTTP 200 with application/pdf. No perimeter signature was present in any response: the hardened validator's block detector matched nothing.
automationBlockRetest.earlierRecordTreatment: The earlier 403 is left exactly as written. It was an access fact about one agent, one network and one date, and this retest is another one. Neither overturns the other and the blocked record is not rewritten.
automationBlockRetest.evasionNote: No control was evaded. The user-agent was not spoofed — the earlier retest that produced the 403 sent a Chrome 126 string and this one sent curl's own — no cookie or token was replayed, no mirror was used, and no route the issuer does not offer was tried.
